revisions.note: REPAIR PASS 2 (revision 5). The inspeQtor found that the previous pass left NO revision on the ledger task it was told to resume: briq-00c still ended at revision 4 while briq-00a/00b/00d each appended one (5/5/7). The substance had been done (that pass regenerated WORK-QUEUE.md - counts 77/141 -> 80/146) but none of it was recorded in this task's own append-only trail, so the resumable queue could not show that the pass re-validated it. I did NOT deliberately skip re-validation - it is re-validated and recorded here. Re-validated in this pass: (1) python3 tools/beta/tests/test_workqueue.py -> 0 failing / 38 passing; (2) python3 tools/beta/workqueue.py verify-schema -> ok=true, 55 tasks, errors=[], dependency graph acyclic, referential integrity enforced, verdict vocabulary closed (12 OFFLINE_TESTED, 1 VERIFIED_ON_S10PLUS backed by an on_device capture, 42 with no verdict yet); (3) render --write then render --check -> exit 0, 'matches the JSON store (55 task(s))', i.e. the human view equals the machine view (an earlier check in this pass exited 1 only because a PARALLEL group had appended a revision to its own task file; regenerating absorbed it - ledger-state counts now 84 revisions / 147 evidence entries); (4) append-only revisions, atomic writes (mkstemp + os.replace) and per-task advisory locks (<id>.json.lock, O_CREAT|O_EXCL) confirmed intact by inspecting tools/beta/workqueue.py. Dependency-ordered resumable remainder: docs/beta-finalization/WORK-QUEUE.md section 6 (42 open tasks: 21 in_progress + 21 pending). No test, schema, lock or rendering defect was found and nothing was refactored or re-seeded.
